engine_description: GPT-5 Nano (usamos GPT 5 mini anteriormente, mas o modelo nano é mais rápido e barato e apresenta resultados de qualidade semelhante)
max_tokens_description: Output token budget (completion + reasoning for GPT-5). Increase if field_completion returns empty with finish_reason=length.
openai_reasoning_effort_description: GPT-5 only: minimal|low|medium|high. Higher effort often improves structured JSON (affiliations/emails) but consumes more of max_tokens; if answers are empty or truncated, raise max_tokens or lower effort. Code default when key is missing is still minimal.
files_to_download_description: Use -1 for all articles (from article_offset onward).
article_offset_description: Skip first N articles (issue order). Batch example: run1 files_to_download=10 offset=0; run2 files_to_download=10 offset=10. If you only raise files_to_download (10→20) without offset, the first 10 are processed again.
skip_fully_processed_articles_descriptio: If true, skip PDF/reference enrichment for articles already fully stored in articles_metadata_apos_do_field_completion.json (same rule as has_empty_fields).
langchain_tracing_description: If false, sets LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2=false so LangSmith does not log runs (large PDF inputs cause 422 ingest errors). Set true only for debugging with smaller prompts.
max_concurrency_description: LangGraph thread pool for parallel Send workers (enrich + field completion). Use 1 for sequential (lower RAM). Omit key or use null for default parallel behaviour.
persist_checkpoint_description: If false, LangGraph runs without SQLite/memory checkpointer (faster; no resume from mid-run). If true, checkpoint under output/{year}/logs/migration_graph_checkpoint.sqlite when sqlite is available.
